messages:
maria: heads-up — release-bot just tagged payment-processor v3.8.0 from a docs-only PR. can someone check?
aj: yikes, bot bumped minor for README updates? that's too noisy.
release-bot: Release created by releasebot/auto-bump. PR #6122 (docs: README + examples). Changed paths: docs/*, README.md. Proposed tag: v3.8.0. No source code changes detected under src/ or pkg/.
david: customers pinning ~3.7.x will interpret this as a feature. we should not signal a minor for docs-only.
sophie: Agreed. If it's docs-only we should make a patch (v3.7.1). Who can remove the tag?
maria: I confirmed PR only touches docs/. No changelog entry. Sophie, please delete v3.8.0 and create v3.7.1.
aj: long-term: propose changing deploy-bot rules: 1) honor PR label prefixed with "release:" (e.g., "release: patch"); 2) path whitelist (docs/, website/, *.md) -> treat as patch unless changelog keywords escalate; 3) include PR labels + file list in release body.
david: also add a keyword scan for "deprecate" or "BREAKING" to force minor/major.
sophie: deleting v3.8.0 and cutting v3.7.1 now. tagging note: "docs-only PR #6122 converted to patch bump".
release-bot: Tag v3.8.0 deleted by @sophie. New tag v3.7.1 created. Release body includes PR labels and changed-paths summary.
aj: i'll open a tiny PR to change the bump heuristic and add support for `release: <patch|minor|major>` in PR body and to surface labels+paths in the generated release note.
maria: thanks. action items: @aj update bot, @maria write tldr RFC about exceptions, @sophie monitor for any pinned-client issues.
david: one more ask — can the bot leave a short explanation when it chooses a minor bump (e.g., "escalated because changelog mentions feat:") so reviewers can triage faster?
aj: absolutely. i'll add an escalation reason field in the body.
sophie: patch live, monitoring. logs look green so far.
maria: closing once we confirm no customer confusion. :thumbsup:
